page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It has no local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge consistently performs within the average middle 50% tier. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions for cryptographic and mathematical operations. Memory bandwidth tests show 1705.41 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. For database and web operations, the instance achieves 28.91 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance, making this instance qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring sustained CPU utilization without virtualization overhead. However, the lack of local storage and GPU acceleration limits its utility for high-speed local caching or heavy deep learning tasks. It is best suited for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
